newsitem.title: USA: Elanco Animal to market cattle implants.
newsitem.headline: Elanco Animal to market cattle implants.

text.p: Elanco Animal Health, a division of Eli Lilly and Co, said Wednesday it will manufacture and market cattle growth implants, beginning January 1, 1997, on an exclusive basis in Canada and all other beef cattle markets outside the United States.
Component line of implants are made by Ivy Laboratories Inc of Overland Park, Kan.

In the United States, the Component line will be marketed exclusively by VetLife Inc, effective January 1, 1997. In a related development, VetLife will be the exclusive U.S. marketer of Compudose cattle growth implants on October 1, 1996, and Elanco will end its Compudose marketing activities in the United States.

"As a result of this strategic agreement, Elanco will offer the most complete line of implants and other products for growth promotion everywhere in the world outside the United States," Bernard Munos, Elanco manager of business development, said in a statement.
